items.title: Shadman’s ‘realisation’ on cracking the conversion code
items.summary: Since scoring a century against Zimbabwe last April, Shadman had gone 17 innings without reaching the three-figure mark, managing four fifties and twice missing out on centuries against Ireland. His struggles, particularly away from home, had raised concerns over his place in the side and Bangladesh’s World Test Championship (WTC) campaign.
